subject: PLG self-serve trial top-up request — AtlasHealth
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: AtlasHealth PLG self-serve credit top-up

Marcus —

Quick heads-up: AtlasHealth (trial account created via PLG signup last month) is hitting heavy API volume and has asked for a self-serve top-up to avoid throttling while they ramp. They are currently in the free trial window and have good engagement: 1.2M tokens in the last 10 days, multiple teams building.

Why I’m asking: they’re in-product, token burn is real, and asking for credits now prevents churn and keeps their product teams running experiments. Sales believes this is a high-propensity conversion (pilot across three business units).

Proposed grant: $75,000 in credits, valid for 90 days.
Requested approvals: leadership sign-off for >$50k grants + confirmation from finance on promotional budget.

Attached: atlas_trial_usage_summary.csv, topup_request.pdf (one-pager: rationale + expected milestones).

Can you review and loop in Laura/Karthik as appropriate? If we approve, sales ops can create a self-serve coupon and I’ll coordinate redemption with Atlas.

Thanks —
Tessa
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: AtlasHealth PLG self-serve credit top-up

Laura —

Forwarding Tessa's note. Quick summary: AtlasHealth is a PLG signup showing heavy usage and priority POC work. Sales is confident on conversion probability but the ask ($75k / 90d) exceeds the standard self-serve cap. My recommendation: approve the $75k top-up as a one-time promo, conditional on:

- Procurement confirmation (PO or acceptance of T&Cs)
- Marketing/Sales TOs (tracked in HubSpot, deal RDW-5621)
- Finance earmarks this against Q1 promotional budget

Rationale: likely to convert to paid seats within 3–6 months (engineering team already running load tests). We can instrument a usage/regression alert and require a check-in at 30 and 75 days. If approved I’ll have Sales Ops create the coupon code (self-serve redemption) and Tessa will enable prefix caching for their account to reduce cost risk.

Would appreciate a quick sign-off so we can issue before their next sprint starts.

— Marcus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Thanks again for the deep engagement from your product teams. Per our internal approvals, we are prepared to issue a one-time, self-serve credit top-up of $75,000. Details below: 

- Coupon: ATLAS-75K-90
- Value: USD 75,000 promotional credit
- Validity: 90 days from activation
- Redemption: Add coupon to your account billing settings (self-serve). Instructions attached.
- Limit: single-account redemption; non-recurring; no auto-renew.

Please confirm acceptance of our Self-Serve Credit Terms (procurement@atlashealth.com on cc). If procurement prefers a PO-based flow, we can arrange a manual invoice/advance and apply any unused balance as account credit.

Karthik is issuing the coupon now; you should see an email with redemption steps and HubSpot deal RDW-5621 will be updated. I’ve attached the approval_matrix.xlsx and our usage summary for your records.
